records.text: Candace Owens said the Bolshevik execution of the Romanov family was led by Yakov Yurovsky, whom she identified as a Talmudic Jew.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The assassination of the Romanov family was led by the Bolshevik executioner Yakov Yurovsky. He was, yes, a Talmudic Jew.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Yakov Yurovsky led the execution squad and came from a Jewish family, but later converted to Lutheranism and became a Bolshevik atheist. Calling him a “Talmudic Jew” at the time of the execution is misleading and not a sound description of his identity.

sources.title: The Murder of the Romanov Family – World History Encyclopedia
sources.relevance: Confirms Yurovsky’s leadership of the execution and describes the killings.

sources.title: Yakov Yurovsky – biographical references
sources.relevance: Documents his family background and later religious conversion; used only for the identity qualifier.

records.text: Candace Owens said the Romanov family was deceived into entering a cellar, where Yurovsky read an execution order and guards shot and bayoneted them.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The family was awakened and told to dress under the guise of being relocated to a safer place. ... They were then led into a cellar room, arranged for a photograph first to quell rumors that they had escaped, and then Yurovsky read out an execution order, surprised them. The guards opened fire in a chaotic bloodbath, but because the daughters had on family jewels that were sewn into their corsets, many of the initial bullets were deflected. It forced the executioners to then use bayonet. ... use bayonets. Women and children bayoneted in the cellar.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Historical accounts agree that the Romanovs were told they were being moved for safety, brought to a cellar, confronted by Yurovsky with an execution order, shot, and finished with bayonets when some initially survived.

sources.title: The Murder of the Romanov Family – World History Encyclopedia
sources.relevance: Confirms the deception, cellar assembly, execution announcement, shooting, and bayonet use.
